text:
sam_marketing: Hey all — draft ready for one quick cross-functional pass: https://docs.google.com/document/d/REDACTED. Need checks on: hero line, benchmark bullets (p50/p95 + cost), webinar CTA copy and final UTM. Target publish Tue 04/12 09:00 PT.

alina_pm: Nice flow. One note: add the workload context for latency (we measured small-batch inference). Avoid superlatives like "fastest".

mike_eng: Numbers we can stand behind: p50 ~40ms, p95 ~115ms for the small-batch harness. Avg token cost from the experiment: $0.00038/token. Also adding cache stat: prefix KV cache hit ~36% (30d). I can drop a 600x160 png sparkline into the doc.

zoe_ops: For the webinar link use: `/webinar/launch-optimize?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=optimize_q2`. HubSpot mapping: source=blog, campaign=optimize_q2.

natalie_legal: Quick legal note: prefer "production-grade" over "industry-leading" unless you have third-party comparisons. "Redwood-verified" is allowed for internal benchmark captions; please include a footnote like "based on Redwood internal tests".

sam_marketing: Thanks — I'll swap the language to "production-grade" and add the footnote. Two asks: Mike, please upload the chart and raw numbers; Natalie, confirm caption clearance for public blog (not press release) by EOD.

publish-bot: PR tracker updated: row 23 (sam_marketing) https://sheets.re/redwood/marketing

mike_eng: Uploaded PNG and numbers to the doc. Also: recommend a short bulleted benchmarks section instead of a long paragraph — easier to scan.

alina_pm: Agreed on bullets. Also tweak CTA to: "Join our launch webinar for a short demo + live Q&A" — more explicit about format.

sam_marketing: Making edits now. Natalie, can you confirm the caption language?

natalie_legal: Confirmed for blog use: "Redwood-verified (internal tests)" is fine. :white_check_mark:

sam_marketing: Perfect. Locking copy by 6pm and scheduling publish + webinar invite. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
